description: A half-kilo box of ridged tubes, machine-cut and dried hard as bone. The box promises "DURUM-CLASS WHEAT ANALOGUE" in a typeface that was reassuring sixty years ago. It cooks up honest enough, which is more than the box does.
name: box of penne
